query: /wrike-time-log <task> work, status moved from In progress to On hold now, 40 minutes after entering In progress
expected_behavior: Reads STATUS history and the user's identity in one turn
Counts only the In progress interval, closed at the current time
Shows the entry and waits for a yes before posting

query: /wrike-time-log <task> after earlier entries exist and the task went In progress, On hold, In progress
expected_behavior: Reads earlier Time log entries and counts only time after the latest through stamp
Does not count the On hold interval
Creates a review entry rounded up to the 30 minute minimum
Keeps work and review as separate entries and sums them in the report

query: /wrike-time-log <task> where a status has an unfamiliar name
expected_behavior: Infers its meaning from name, group and sequence, and asks once only if still unclear
